newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian ALZ says fire damage 1 bln bfr.
newsitem.headline: Belgian ALZ says fire damage 1 bln bfr.

text.p: Belgian stainless steel maker ALZ NV, a unit of the Luxembourg Arbed group, said a fire late Tuesday at its Genk plant caused about one billion Belgian francs of damage but production would not be disrupted.
"The fire affected a coil grinding machine - it is in the finishing lines and it will not stop continuity," ALZ communications manager Marc Brueck told Reuters on Wednesday.
ALZ produced 485,000 tonnes of stainless steel in 1995 and is due to increase that to 700,000 tonnes by the end of 1997.
